title: Relationships
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for relationships.

items.definition_en: to have a friendly relationship
items.example: I get along well with my cousins.

items.definition_en: to help someone emotionally or practically
items.example: Good friends support each other.

items.definition_en: belief that someone is honest and reliable
items.example: Trust takes time to develop.

items.definition_en: an angry disagreement
items.example: They had an argument about money.

title: Education
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for education.

items.definition_en: a series of lessons in a subject
items.example: She enrolled in an evening course.

items.definition_en: a piece of work given to a student
items.example: The assignment is due on Monday.

items.definition_en: to become or make something better
items.example: Reading daily will improve your vocabulary.

items.definition_en: a mark given for academic work
items.example: He received a high grade in science.

title: Jobs and Careers
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for jobs and careers.

items.definition_en: to formally ask for a job
items.example: She applied for a teaching position.

items.definition_en: regular payment for professional work
items.example: The job offers a competitive salary.

items.definition_en: knowledge gained by doing something
items.example: Work experience can strengthen your application.

items.definition_en: a duty that you are expected to perform
items.example: Managing the schedule is my responsibility.

title: Travel
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for travel.

items.definition_en: a place to stay while travelling
items.example: We booked affordable accommodation near the centre.

items.definition_en: the act or time of leaving
items.example: Our departure is scheduled for noon.

items.definition_en: the place to which someone travels
items.example: Rome was our final destination.

items.definition_en: visiting interesting places as a tourist
items.example: We spent the afternoon sightseeing.

title: Technology Basics
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for technology basics.

items.definition_en: a piece of electronic equipment
items.example: This device measures your heart rate.

items.definition_en: to copy data from the internet
items.example: Download the document before the lesson.

items.definition_en: a secret set of characters used for access
items.example: Choose a strong password for your account.

items.definition_en: to join a device to a network
items.example: Connect the laptop to the wireless network.

title: Environment Basics
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for environment basics.

items.definition_en: to process waste so it can be used again
items.example: Our building recycles paper and glass.

items.definition_en: harmful substances in the environment
items.example: Traffic causes serious air pollution.

items.definition_en: to keep someone or something safe
items.example: These rules protect local wildlife.

items.definition_en: unwanted material that is thrown away
items.example: The restaurant is reducing food waste.

title: Money
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for money.

items.definition_en: to have enough money for something
items.example: We cannot afford a larger apartment.

items.definition_en: a plan for spending available money
items.example: The family follows a monthly budget.

items.definition_en: to take something and return it later
items.example: Can I borrow some money for the ticket?

items.definition_en: to keep money for future use
items.example: She saves part of her salary each month.

title: Communication
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for communication.

items.definition_en: to speak briefly about something
items.example: He mentioned the problem during lunch.

items.definition_en: to answer someone
items.example: Please reply to the email by Friday.

items.definition_en: a belief or judgement
items.example: Everyone expressed an opinion in the discussion.

items.definition_en: to stop someone while they are speaking
items.example: It is rude to interrupt a speaker.

title: Emotions and Personality
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for emotions and personality.

items.definition_en: feeling sure about your abilities
items.example: She felt confident before the interview.

items.definition_en: able to wait without becoming annoyed
items.example: A good teacher is calm and patient.

items.definition_en: unhappy because hopes were not met
items.example: He was disappointed with the result.

items.definition_en: willing to give time or money
items.example: It was generous of her to offer help.

title: Daily Problems
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for daily problems.

items.definition_en: a period of waiting caused by lateness
items.example: A traffic delay made us late.

items.definition_en: to fix something that is damaged
items.example: A technician repaired the washing machine.

items.definition_en: to say that you are dissatisfied
items.example: Customers complained about the slow service.

items.definition_en: a way to solve a problem
items.example: We found a simple solution to the issue.

title: Common Phrasal Verbs
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for common phrasal verbs.

items.definition_en: to discover information
items.example: I found out when the course begins.

items.definition_en: to take care of someone or something
items.example: She looks after her younger brother.

items.definition_en: to stop trying or doing something
items.example: Do not give up after one mistake.

items.definition_en: to make a device start working
items.example: Please turn on the lights.

title: Common Collocations
description: Build accurate, usable vocabulary for common collocations.

items.definition_en: to choose after considering options
items.example: We need to make a decision today.

items.definition_en: to stop an activity briefly to rest
items.example: Let us take a break after this task.

items.definition_en: to listen to or watch carefully
items.example: Pay attention to the final instruction.

items.definition_en: to continue communicating
items.example: We keep in touch by email.
